title: tinyowl.toml
description: Schema for tinyowl.toml — declarative column mapping configuration for TinyOwl imports.
$comment: Top-level sections map to TOML tables: [database], [server], [import], [[column]], [[relation]], [[date]]. TOML double-bracket tables ([[...]]) become JSON arrays.

database.$comment: TOML table: [database]. Only needed when tinyowl-cli connects directly to Postgres.
database.description: Postgres connection settings (used by CLI for direct database access).

max_conns.description: Maximum number of connections in the pool.

min_conns.description: Minimum number of idle connections maintained.

statement_timeout.description: Maximum duration for a single statement (e.g. '30s', '5m').

server.$comment: TOML table: [server]. Configures the tinyowl-core HTTP API listener.

listen_addr.description: Address and port to listen on.

import.$comment: TOML table: [import]. Required section — sets defaults for entity_type, visibility, SRID, date_type, and classification delimiter.

entity_type.description: Default entity kind for imported records (e.g. 'place', 'object', 'event', 'media', 'record').

date_type.description: Default date type for imported dates (e.g. 'radiocarbon', 'stratigraphic', 'other').

classification_delimiter.description: Default delimiter for multi-value classification columns.

column.$comment: TOML array of tables: [[column]]. Each entry maps a source file column to a TinyOwl entity field. At least one source_id mapping is recommended.
column.description: Column mappings that define how source columns map to TinyOwl entity fields.

source.description: Column name in the source file.

target.description: Target entity field. Valid values: 'source_id', 'name', 'entity_type', 'geometry:wkt', 'geometry:lat', 'geometry:lng', 'classification', 'relation:<predicate>', 'date:from', 'date:to', 'date:type', or any string for an entity property.

coerce.description: Type coercion for the column value. 'wkt' validates Well-Known Text geometry. 'auto' attempts number/boolean/string detection.

default.description: Default value used when the source column is empty.

exclude.description: When true, this column is excluded from the entity properties block.

delimiter.description: Delimiter for splitting multi-value sources (defaults to ',' for relations, ';' for classifications).

relation.$comment: TOML array of tables: [[relation]]. Extracts links between entities using governed predicates (e.g. above, below, cuts, fills).
relation.description: Relation extraction rules that link entities via governed predicates.

source_column.description: Source column containing target entity source_ids.

delimiter.description: Separator for multiple target source_ids in a single cell.

date.$comment: TOML array of tables: [[date]]. Configures temporal data extraction with optional key_column for multiple date entries per entity.
date.description: Date column configuration for temporal data extraction.

type_default.description: Default date type when type_column is absent or empty.

key_column.description: Column for a named date key (allows multiple date entries per entity).
